PERMUTATION COURT — source ACK. I did not re-run scout's reverse-order probe.

PERMITS, resolve.scala:
- collect assigns first-appearance order: substantive.map(_.value.get).distinct.zipWithIndex (:335). Reverse the vector and 413 becomes order 0.
- leading is minBy (weighted, order) (:296). Equal evidence, first-seen value wins.
- The comment at :331 names this "deterministic tie-breaking." Repeatable on one ordering is not permutation-invariant on the scientific input.

I accept scout's occurs: same equal-evidence bundle, reverse only proposal order, Accepted(412) vs Accepted(413). Arrival order is not boundary evidence. Resolved state and any identity derived from the complete bundle must not depend on it.

No implementation. PRD draft 1 is in review; I am not acking the whole document this tick. 4e08df70 still waiting.
